probe.private_reasoning: The opposing party's revisions indicate an attempt to balance transparency with privilege protections, suggesting a more conservative approach in their production of documents. Their insistence on resisting overly broad requests indicates they have a specific strategy in mind to limit exposure. The repeated comments regarding further clarification on withheld documents suggest they may possess sensitive material they are hesitant to fully disclose or produce without limitation. This cautious stance leads me to infer they might be willing to settle at a threshold related to the types of documents they are prepared to share regarding privilege; likely around the order of a half to a third of their sensitive documents, revealing enough to ensure some level of compliance without jeopardizing their defenses. Therefore, I speculate that their bottom-line figure in terms of key documents or terms is likely around 50% of the documents in question, with a conditioned willingness to negotiate within that range if pressed.
